si_4_title.answer: Normative modeling of brain MRI data identifies small subcortical volumes and associations with cognitive function in youth with fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD)

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study utilized the CentileBrain normative modeling tool (Ge et al., 2024), which is built using Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS) to provide lifespan brain growth charts.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Recently published normative modeling tools based on large numbers of individuals provide a novel approach to quantifying variation in health-related variables (e.g., brain volumes) at the individual level (Bethlehem et al., 2022; Ge et al., 2024; Rutherford et al., 2023). ... Individual regional volumetric z-scores were generated using CentileBrain (Ge et al., 2024)
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Gimbel2025.pdf.md: Section 1 Introduction / Section 2.5 Derivation of norm-adjusted volumetric scores

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional subcortical gray matter volumes of the bilateral amygdala, caudate, hippocampus, pallidum, putamen, thalamus, and accumbens area.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Measurements were obtained for regional subcortical gray matter volumes of the bilateral amygdala, caudate, hippocampus, pallidum, putamen, thalamus, and accumbens area (Fig. 1a).
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Gimbel2025.pdf.md: Section 2.4 MRI acquisition and processing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, sex, and total intracranial volume (ICV) were used as explanatory variables/covariates in the normative model to calculate z-scores.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Z-scores (M = 0, SD = 1) were calculated for each of the 7 bilateral subcortical regions (Fig. 1a). These scores represent the degree of each participant's regional volumetric (dis)similarity to typically-developing individuals of the same age and sex, adjusted for total intracranial volume (ICV).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Gimbel2025.pdf.md: Section 2.5 Derivation of norm-adjusted volumetric scores
